PlatformConfigName.description: The identifier this board gives the device. A platform configuration refers to the device by it, which pairs the device with this record, and the device is named by it on D-Bus.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

PollRate.description: Poll the device at this rate, specified in milliseconds, to fetch sensors
